title: Structured finance reconciliation and artifact delivery
customer_role: Small-business bookkeeper or individual budget owner
business_problem: Reconcile receipt facts with imported transactions, preserve balance and deduplication invariants, route conflicts, and deliver a validated audit artifact.
models: optional versioned receipt classifier or matcher
external_systems: Actual Budget via generated SDK or CLI bridge
workflow_result: A generated workflow builds a typed SDK or CLI contract, validates and transforms finance data, reconciles records, routes conflicts, writes approved updates exactly once, and emits an independently checked artifact.
independent_oracle: Hidden transactions and receipts check schema, types, exact amounts, balance invariants, rule ordering, deduplication, artifact cells, SDK or CLI receipts, retry behavior, and zero unauthorized mutations.
revision_semantics: Revision 1 is authorized after EXP-LILIES-003 and EXP-LILIES-004 closed. EXP-LILIES-001 keeps its formal-evidence result and is not rewritten as passed.
next_action: Freeze the server and API package versions, CLI help, budget fixture, rule baseline, secrets, seeds, and oracle.
